name: Zealot

features.Minion: The zealot’s attacks can’t critically hit, and they’re immediately defeated when they suffer an injury.
features.Fanatical: Intimidation and Persuasion tests against the zealot gain a disadvantage.
features.Frenzied: While the zealot is at half health or less, they can’t use the Brace action, but their movement rate increases by 10 feet and their damage rolls gain an advantage.

Strike: Longsword.Description: Attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 4 (1d8) keen damage. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) keen damage.

Brace.Description: The zealot raises their shield, and attacks against them gain a disadvantage until the start of the zealot’s next turn.

Inspire Zeal.Description: The zealot inspires an ally they can influence within 20 feet of them. That ally can immediately use the Strike action as ↩.

Tactics: A zealot fights with fanaticism. They and their fellow zealots crowd around enemies and attack recklessly with their Longsword. As a battle grows more violent and their companions become Frenzied, a zealot uses Inspire Zeal to encourage courage and brutality in the face of death.
